description: Kinetic match settings (#15685): forces and torques for a kinematic best match by inverse dynamics and allocation. One minimum-effort solution in the null space of the closed arm loop, never a unique answer.
limits_note: Plausibility limits, not acceptance: published driver swings report hand-on-club forces under about 1 kN and joint torques of a few hundred N m. A result above them is reported implausible with its reasons. closure_tolerance_m is the hand-on-club pose residual each frame is projected to before inverse dynamics; an open weld turns the grip force into a fake external moment.
